profile.headline: Java & Cloud Solutions Engineer | Focused on Clean, Scalable Backend Platforms | AWS Specialist
profile.summary: DevOps-focused Software Engineer with extensive experience in cloud infrastructure and system reliability, specializing in AWS cloud environments. Proven track record of deploying, managing, and optimizing cloud-based systems with expertise in infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and serverless architectures. Demonstrated ability to improve system observability, implement security best practices, and collaborate effectively in distributed team environments. Committed to enhancing system performance, scalability, and reliability through strategic automation and proactive problem-solving.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built Java-based AWS Lambda functions supporting customer onboarding and backend middleware integrations, improving system reliability and scalability.
• Automated customer onboarding process, reducing onboarding timeframe from days to minutes, and saving 10–20 hours per week of manual processes.
• Enhanced legacy Spring application scalability, enabling the platform to handle 100x more daily messages to meet increased demand.
• Developed custom authentication library for secure access integration, supporting ~150 customers, each with multiple user accounts, across platforms.
• Spearheaded Veracode adoption, mitigating several high-severity vulnerabilities and reducing medium-severity security issues by over 50%.
• Managed deployment of AWS applications using CloudFormation and SAM templates, ensuring consistency and reliability with CI/CD pipeline integration.
• Enhanced data handling by implementing and debugging Postgres stored procedures, optimizing retrieval and storage for faster performance.
